encounter: E0171 TRAINER_NORMAN_1 (Petalburg Gym leader, Balance Badge, cap 42, Medium) - attempt 3 rebuild
availability_audit: Cap-42 window covers Route 111 / Ashen Woods / Petalburg Gym (battle_index campaign_order 151-171). Gates: Alakazam 20 (Abra Granite Cave + Linking Cord from Slateport evolution stock), Incineroar 36 (Torracat, Heat Badge window), Spiritomb 14 (AlteringCave_1F land table), Scizor 30 (Scyther + Metal Coat; Scizorite stone-window 30), Weavile 14 (Sneasel), Gengar 30 (Haunter + Linking Cord). Every source map is entered strictly before Petalburg Gym in book chapter order. No cap-42-gated desert species, no legendaries, no Paradox species.
plan: Third configuration, built from the two losses. Fix 1: attempt 1's Mega Alakazam had a forced Trace that copied Slaking's Truant the moment Neutralizing Gas dropped and loafed itself to death, so Alakazam runs Magic Guard with a Life Orb instead (no recoil, no Trace) and the Mega Ring goes to Scizor. Its Psychic still one-shots the 252/252 Bold Galarian Weezing, whose Special Defense is its one soft side. Fix 2: attempt 2 proved that a Choice Band Slaking at L44 one-shots any body that does not resist or blank its move, so the team is built out of immunities rather than bulk. Spiritomb (Ghost/Dark) is immune to Slaking's Double-Edge and Hammer Arm, to Meloetta's Psychic and Hyper Voice, to Indeedee's Expanding Force and to Porygon2's Tri Attack all at once, and its Will-O-Wisp permanently halves Slaking's Attack. Gengar adds the second Slaking blank (Ghost stops Double-Edge and Hammer Arm, Levitate stops High Horsepower once the Gas is gone). Fix 3: Shadow Ball is dead weight against five of Norman's six, so Gengar carries Psychic instead, and the Dark/Bug answers to Indeedee and Meloetta are Incineroar's Darkest Lariat, Weavile's Knock Off and Mega Scizor's Bug Bite.
